\chapter{The Last Four Shown Forms}
\label{ch:gu-final-script-closure-b}
\hlchaptermodality{7}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can read and write \gu{ૂ}, \gu{ટ}, \gu{ઈ}, and \gu{ઢ}, completing the script inventory shown in this book.}

With every model covered, read \gu{ૂ}, \gu{ટ}, \gu{ઈ}, and \gu{ઢ} and write each one from a spoken sound or role cue, keeping reading and writing scores separate.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[ū]{\gu{ૂ} — the long-ū sign}

\label{lesson:GU-W07-uu-matra}



\begin{quote}
Write \textbf{\gu{મુ}} once with the short-\emph{u} hook below \textbf{\gu{મ}}. Put it away. Long \emph{ū} uses a longer below-hook, but it still needs a consonant host.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — meet one form}
Keep \textbf{\gu{મૂ}} visible. The sign \textbf{\gu{ૂ}} attaches below the consonant as a longer hook. Read \textbf{\gu{મૂ}} as \emph{mū}: consonant first, then long vowel.

\subsection*{Writing — notice and trace}
Finger-trace only the longer below-hook in \textbf{\gu{મૂ}}, then air-trace it once. Keep the hook below the host and make its extra length visible.

\subsection*{Writing — copy with the model}
Copy visible \textbf{\gu{મૂ}} once. Compare \textbf{\gu{મુ} / \gu{મૂ}} and repair only the hook length if the two forms look alike.

\subsection*{Writing — recall after hiding}
Hide the model and write \emph{mū} once. Uncover \textbf{\gu{મૂ}}, compare, and stop after one repair.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Point to long \emph{ū} in \textbf{\gu{મુ} \gu{મૂ}}, then write only its dependent sign.

Source: \href{https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0A80.pdf}{Unicode Gujarati chart}; placement and example follow \texttt{data/scripts/gujarati.json}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[ṭa]{\gu{ટ} — retroflex tta}

\label{lesson:GU-W07-tta}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\gu{મૂ}} once and point to its long-\emph{ū} sign. Then write dental \textbf{\gu{ત}} once and say \emph{ta} with the tongue at the teeth. Curl the tongue back for retroflex \emph{tta}, then put the old shapes away.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — meet one form}
Keep \textbf{\gu{ટ}} visible. Sweep across the rounded upper turn, bend diagonally down through the middle, then circle the broad lower bowl and finish on its right side without lifting.

\subsection*{Writing — notice and trace}
Finger-trace \textbf{\gu{ટ}} once, then air-trace it once. Notice upper turn, diagonal middle, lower bowl; no pen lift.

\subsection*{Writing — copy with the model}
Copy visible \textbf{\gu{ટ}} once. Compare only the diagonal middle and lower bowl; repair one landmark if needed.

\subsection*{Writing — recall after hiding}
Hide the model and write retroflex \emph{tta} once. Uncover \textbf{\gu{ટ}}, compare, and stop after one repair.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Read \textbf{\gu{ત} \gu{ટ}} aloud and keep dental \emph{ta} apart from retroflex \emph{tta}.

Sources: \href{https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/}{Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice} and the \href{https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0A80.pdf}{Unicode Gujarati chart}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[ī]{\gu{ઈ} — independent long ī}

\label{lesson:GU-W07-independent-ii}



\begin{quote}
Write attached long-\emph{ī} sign \textbf{\gu{ી}} once and say “needs a consonant.” Put it away. Long \emph{ī} standing alone needs a whole letter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — meet one form}
Keep \textbf{\gu{ઈ}} visible. Circle the small upper-left loop to the middle crossing, continue around the broad lower loop, then rise along the right and curl around the extended top hook without lifting.

\subsection*{Writing — notice and trace}
Finger-trace \textbf{\gu{ઈ}} once, then air-trace it once. Notice upper loop, middle crossing, lower loop, extended top curl; no pen lift.

\subsection*{Writing — copy with the model}
Copy visible \textbf{\gu{ઈ}} once. Compare only the middle crossing and top curl; repair one landmark if needed.

\subsection*{Writing — recall after hiding}
Hide the model and write independent long \emph{ī} once. Uncover \textbf{\gu{ઈ}}, compare, and stop after one repair.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Point to the whole vowel in \textbf{\gu{ઈ} \gu{ી}}, then point to the attached sign.

Sources: \href{https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/}{Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice} and the \href{https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0A80.pdf}{Unicode Gujarati chart}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[ḍha]{\gu{ઢ} — retroflex ddha}

\label{lesson:GU-W07-ddha}



\begin{quote}
Write dental \textbf{\gu{ધ}} once and say \emph{dha} with the tongue at the teeth. Curl the tongue back and keep the breathy release for retroflex \emph{ddha}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — meet one form}
Keep \textbf{\gu{ઢ}} visible. Sweep right across the high shoulder, descend through the middle and circle the broad outer lower bowl, then continue around the small inner loop without lifting.

\subsection*{Writing — notice and trace}
Finger-trace \textbf{\gu{ઢ}} once, then air-trace it once. Notice high shoulder, outer bowl, inner loop; no pen lift.

\subsection*{Writing — copy with the model}
Copy visible \textbf{\gu{ઢ}} once. Compare only the outer bowl and inner loop; repair one landmark if needed.

\subsection*{Writing — recall after hiding}
Hide the model and write retroflex \emph{ddha} once. Uncover \textbf{\gu{ઢ}}, compare, and stop after one repair.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Read \textbf{\gu{ધ} \gu{ઢ}} aloud and keep dental \emph{dha} apart from retroflex \emph{ddha}.

Sources: \href{https://www.t30apps.com/gujarati-alphabet-writing/}{Gujarati Alphabet Writing Practice} and the \href{https://www.unicode.org/charts/PDF/U0A80.pdf}{Unicode Gujarati chart}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[attached long uu — retroflex tta …]{\gu{ૂ} — \gu{ટ} — \gu{ઈ} — \gu{ઢ}: the final four return}

\label{lesson:GU-R07-second-four-r1}



\begin{quote}
Keep the four cards visible. Point as you say attached long \emph{ū}, retroflex \emph{tta}, independent long \emph{ī}, and retroflex aspirated \emph{ddha}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Read the row once from left to right. Name \textbf{\gu{ૂ}} as an attached sign and \textbf{\gu{ઈ}} as an independent vowel. Record a reading score out of four.

\subsection*{Writing — from sound or role}
Cover every model. Write the four cues in order. Record a separate writing score out of four; a reading point cannot replace a written form. Aim for \textbf{4/4} in each column, with one focused repair allowed.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Write the attached sign and independent vowel from sound, then name which one needs a consonant host.
\end{tcolorbox}
